# Callouts: Recovery 4a - normal-boot listen with the adapter on this PC

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/rec4a_wiring.jpg](../../../images/annotated/rec4a_wiring.jpg)
